{{Tabs|Regular = Snowballer|Perk = Golden Snowballer}} {{EventObtain|date = 15th of January 2025|event = [[Operation I.C.E Event]]}} {{For|other uses of [[Snow (Disambiguation)|Snow]]}} {{TowerInfobox |title = Snowballer |image-static = SnowballerIcon.png |image-dynamic = SnowballerDynamic.png |image-dynamic-start = 0 |unlockcost = Triumph [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] on Easy difficulty |basecost = {{Money|300}} |basesellingprice = {{Money|100}} |role = Defense |placement = Ground |basedamage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]3 |damagetype = Splash |basefirerate = [[File:Cooldown_Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]1.5 |baserange = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]15 |footprint = 1.25 |hidden_detection = N/A |lead_detection = {{Attr|Lead|Level 0+}} |flying_detection = {{Attr|Flying|Level 3}} |tooltip-1 = A cheap tower that can be quickly upgraded to provide some freezing AOE support. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A jolly snowball fighter who prefers to fight in the best way they know how!|Store Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Snowballer''' is an exclusive offensive support [[Towers|tower]] that could have been obtained by triumphing [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] on the Easy difficulty. It could be obtained via a gamepass for {{Robux|249}}. The '''Snowballer''' throws snowballs at enemies, dealing splash damage to them. These snowballs also apply chillness , which slows them down. At Level 3, it can also freeze enemies for a few seconds after reaching max chillness. These snowballs are explosive, dealing damage to multiple enemies in the explosion. These enemies receive damage based on their distance from the center of the explosion. The further away they are, the less damage they receive. Additionally, this also grants it the ability to bypass enemy defense. The '''Snowballer''' can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies from Level 0 and detect [[Flying]] enemies on Level 3. The '''Snowballer''' is mainly considered to be an early-game tower due to its low cost and low DPS, however it can provide decent stalling later on during the game. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Snow Day|Cost = {{Money|50}}|Image = [[File:Freezer Upgrade 1.png|100px]]|Information = 1.5 > 1.35 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +2.5 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|116}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 2|Upgrade Title = Frigid Temperatures|Cost = {{Money|320}}|Image = [[File:Freezer Upgrade 2.png|100px]]|Information = +3 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] 20% > 30% Max Slowdown [[File:Slowness.png|20px|Max Slowdown]] 10% > 15% Slowdown per Hit [[File:Slowness.png|20px|Slowdown per Hit]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|223}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 3|Upgrade Title = Snowball Cannon|Cost = {{Money|3,000}}|Image = [[File:Freezer Upgrade 3.png|100px]]|Information = 1.35 > 1.25 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +2.5 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] +22 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +1 Max Hits +Flying Detection {{Flying|Flying Detection}} Freezes enemies when slowdown is higher than Max Slowdown •0.6 Freeze Time [[File:Slowness.png|20px|Freeze Time]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|1,223}}}} ==Statistics== ''To see all the previous statistics of this tower, see the [[/History|history]] page.'' {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $CE$ = Total Cost / DPS $TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$ $COST$ = 300; 50; 320; 3000 $FSE-DETECTION$ = ; 0; 3 $FSE-UPGRADE$ = Snow Day; Frigid Temperatures; Snowball Cannon $FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = 15686418975; 15686418835; 15686418748 $FSE-META$ = Exclusive; File:SnowballerIcon.png $R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$

Cost |N/A |- !Obtained From |Exclusive |} ==Strategy== *The '''Snowballer's''' DPS makes it only reliable as an offensive tower in the early game, though even there it can struggle in harder modes like [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and special modes. **This means that it is mostly a support tower used to slow down enemies in harder modes, though it can be used as an early-game tower in easier modes quite well. **If you want to use the '''Snowballer''' for early game, it is best to try get it to Level 3 as fast as possible, since it will be able to damage more enemies per attack as well as freeze enemies. *The '''Snowballer''' can slow down and later, freeze enemies with its snowballs. **Do note, however, that the '''Snowballer''' can only hit up to 2 enemies at Level 0-2, making it worse against crowds in comparison to other freezing towers like the [[Cryomancer]] or [[Frost Blaster]]. ***However, it is very cheap to fully upgrade the '''Snowballer''', where it can hit up to four enemies, which makes it a good option for handling weaker crowds that are not immune to freeze. *Because of how cheap it is, the '''Snowballer''' can be used to deal with [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies from Level 0 and with [[Flying]] enemies from Level 3. **The '''Snowballer''' especially excels at taking down early game [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] and [[Flying]] enemies thanks to its splash damage and freezing capabilities. ==Trivia== *The '''Snowballer''' is the second tower to have only three upgrades, with the first being the [[Hallow Punk]]. *The '''Snowballer''' has the lowest total upgrade cost in the game. *During [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], if Easy difficulty was selected, the '''Snowballer''' would be included in all loadouts as a sixth
